headline: Maryville beats Missouri-St. Louis, then holds McKendree
dek: Missouri-St. Louis conceded thirteen goals all season and lost to no conference side until Maryville beat them. Maryville then kept McKendree off the scoresheet as well.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Lincoln, Indianapolis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell scored fewer goals between them than McKendree did alone.

wire.line: McKendree won sixteen matches, more than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Missouri-St. Louis lost twice all season, to Pittsburg State and to Maryville.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Maddie Mauch scored nineteen goals for McKendree from 121 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jessie Newton, a midfielder, made seventeen assists for Quincy.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mikayla Thomas kept six clean sheets for Truman.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: William Jewell finished without a win and scored four goals across the season.

last_match.line: Maryville came into it off a win over Missouri-St. Louis; McKendree off a win at Missouri S&T.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
